stripe.description: Connect your Stripe account for one-time payments and subscriptions.
stripe.secretWhatIsIt: The secret Stripe issues when you register this webhook URL. It verifies that events came from Stripe; it is separate from the product ID configured in the offers section.
stripe.secretWhereToFind: Stripe Dashboard → Developers → Webhooks → select the endpoint → Signing secret → Reveal. Paste the complete whsec_... value here.
stripe.productIdInstructions: In Stripe Dashboard → Products, open the product and copy its Price ID. Create one offer for each price you sell.

capabilities.offerMapping: Offer mapping for each Checkout item

guru.description: Connect D. Manager Guru through Digital Manager → Integrações → Postback.
guru.producerIdWhatIsIt: The numeric ID of your Guru account. Purchase events include it, and Open Members checks it as an additional consistency signal. Keep the webhook URL secret; the producer ID is not a credential.
guru.producerIdWhereToFind: In D. Manager Guru, open Minha conta → Perfil and copy the producer ID. It can also appear in the URL of a product details page.
guru.productIdInstructions: In D. Manager Guru, open the product and copy its numeric ID from the URL or the product details. Create one offer for each product you sell.

generic.name: Generic webhook
generic.tagline: Any provider that can send JSON by POST
generic.description: A general endpoint for platforms without a dedicated integration. The payload needs at least email and transaction_id; product_id is optional.
generic.secretWhatIsIt: A long random value chosen by you. The provider must send it in the Authorization: Bearer header on every webhook so Open Members can authenticate the request.
generic.secretWhereToFind: Generate a value locally, for example with `openssl rand -hex 32`, paste it here, and configure the provider to send the same value in the Authorization header.
generic.productIdInstructions: Use the exact value the provider sends as product_id. If the payload has no product_id, leave mappings empty and configure a fallback access level.
